development_baseline.lineage_review: Pinned input scripts use OSM roads/facilities and union of UNOSAT plus ARC/WFP flood extents. They do not explicitly import the reserved road-constraint layer. This does not establish independent partner observation lineage.

evaluation_registration.resource_policy: All listed constraint resources remain reserved; exclude WMS map from row evaluation; no selection by observed outcome.
evaluation_registration.outcome_hash_status: not downloaded; provider hash fields are empty; originalHash is not a cryptographic content freeze
evaluation_registration.vehicle_class: not established by catalog; generic schema speed fields do not establish observed speed or mode
evaluation_registration.observation_dates: catalog date and file update dates are not row observation times
evaluation_registration.coverage: Only roads with access-constraint information; unreported roads remain unknown, never passable negatives.
evaluation_registration.lineage: Shared OSM geometry and same event as development. Partner reports may overlap development flood evidence; independence not established.
eligibility_rules: Obtain immutable licensed bytes through a custodian; hash raw archives before anyone opens outcome rows.
Before outcome access, record metadata-supported observation window, transport mode, spatial coverage, status definitions and exclusions.
Exclude entries lacking time/mode/locatable road linkage or explicit observation provenance; freeze rule and excluded-reason vocabulary before outcomes are opened.
Require documented observation lineage independent of development inputs and model-generated flood closures. Shared geometry alone is not independent validation.
Freeze development input hashes, at least two independently sourced bound families, models, sampling policies, costs, metrics and matching rules before outcome access.
Do not tune or choose widths, corridors or dates from reserved outcomes. If lineage cannot be separated, retain as development-only or seek a separate event.
A future amendment with evidence and new hashes is required to change ineligibility. This file does not claim a frozen row-level evaluation set.
